newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Bank Austria says may up Bank Austria, CA div.
newsitem.headline: Bank Austria says may up Bank Austria, CA div.

text.p: Bank Austria said on Monday it saw potential to up its and Creditanstalt's 1997 dividend payment and forecast a group operating profit of at least 12 billion schillings.
"(An increased dividend) looks to be a possibility for the entire group," said Bank Austria director Karl Samstag in response to reporters' questions.
Bank Austria and Creditanstalt each paid a 12 schillings per share dividend for 1996.
He added the group was "more likely than not to exceed" its target of a 12 billion schillings full-year operating profit. -- Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
